text:
We may collect personal data (name, email, phone) within the context of our contact forms or project
                    requests, solely with your consent.

Data is used to respond to your requests, inform you about our services, and improve your experience
                    on the site.

The processing of your data relies on your explicit consent or the necessity of executing a service
                    request.

Your data is kept for a period strictly necessary for achieving the purposes mentioned above, in
                    accordance with applicable legislation.

You have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. To exercise these rights, please
                    contact us.

This site uses a minimum number of cookies necessary for its proper functioning and for anonymous
                    audience measurement.
